title: POST /api/v1/agent/connectivity/wireguard (request)
description: Register this device's WireGuard public key (the private key never leaves the device) and its SSH facts.

ssh_user.description: Login name; never starts with '-', no '/', '.' or spaces.

ssh_host_key.description: sshd host public key '<type> <base64> [comment]'; the server checks that the blob matches the type.

ssh_ca_public_key.description: The SSH CA this device already trusts, if any.
